question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The athlete's performance was ________, earning him a standing ovation.
solution:
The correct answer is: **exceptional**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Exceptional"** refers to something that is unusually good or outstanding. (असाधारण)

 
 
• **Example: **His exceptional skills earned him a place on the national team.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the athlete's performance was exceptional, earning him a standing ovation.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. exceptional.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Moderate** (मध्यम): Average in amount, intensity, quality, or degree.

 
 
• **Example:** The weather was moderate, neither too hot nor too cold.
 
 
 
• **Average** (औसत): The typical or normal amount, quality, degree, etc.
 
 
• **Example:** His performance was average, not standing out in any particular way.
 
 
 
• **"M****e**diocre" (औसत दर्जे का): Something of only average quality; not very good.
 
 
• Example: Her performance was mediocre, and she did not stand out among the other athletes.
